title: Deeper/broader ACIS peer availability and reproducible validation route
mode: Primary-source web research and local plan reconciliation; plan-only
scope: Recheck whether the reviewed open-source DWG/DXF peer set provides an independent ACIS semantic kernel suitable for general B-rep qualification.
Resolve the ezdxf SAT/SAB producer documentation boundary and distinguish carrier tools, record parsers, geometry kernels, DWG AcDs ownership, and native consumers.
Refine PAR-07/S8 validation so fast implementation slices remain local and external modeler checks stay optional at the composed gate.

sources.revision: Stable documentation identified as ezdxf 1.4.5, accessed 2026-10-20; no package or code was executed
sources.observed: The ACIS API documents loading, SAT and SAB export, and construction helpers. It also limits supported ACIS records, says unsupported records become NONE_ENTITY with data loss, and warns that arbitrary ACIS cannot be loaded and re-exported. The FAQ conflicts by claiming only SAT write support and no ACIS creation/editing.
sources.limits: Documentation does not prove the exact package operation works for every requested profile. Pin an artifact and run a narrow API probe before using the producer. ezdxf is not a general geometry kernel or semantic oracle.

sources.revision: Mutable catalog/product pages accessed 2026-10-20; no component package or kernel was installed or run
sources.observed: The public preview identifies ACIS SAT/SAB exchange as an added-value commercial component separate from the open-source OCCT core. An exact authorized component could provide a distinct translator implementation, but its shape kernel lineage is OCCT, shared with FreeCAD and cq-acis.
sources.limits: Not an available open-source-core reader, not required for local implementation, and not an independent-kernel vote against OCCT-derived paths.

sources.revision: Mutable issue/source/NEWS pages accessed 2026-10-20; issue names LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at commit 8a1ae764; no binary or drawing was obtained or executed
sources.observed: Issue #1411 describes a scratch-generatable AC1032 DXF REGION with SAB carried by ACDSDATA and reports empty ACIS geometry after conversion through the named build. LibreDWG source and NEWS describe AcDs handling as incomplete/fallback in relevant paths.
sources.limits: A reported peer failure is not a current reproduced result or a local libdxfrw defect. Use only as a generated-control design lead; do not import its confidential sample.

sources.project: cq-acis, CADMPEG, and FreeCAD route lineage
sources.revision: Mutable project pages accessed 2026-10-20; no package, kernel, or native application executed
sources.observed: cq-acis is a subset ACIS-to-OCCT shape route with known kernel overlap with FreeCAD; existing research notes CADMPEG/ezdxf format-discovery overlap. Stock FreeCAD DXF import does not consume ACIS/SAT blobs.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: make carrier parsing, ACIS record graph completeness, shape construction, DWG AcDs ownership, and native application acceptance separate outcomes
PAR-07/S8: use local generated SAT/SAB controls and hand-computed analytic expectations on the fast lane; defer optional external kernel work to one composed checkpoint
External evidence: do not mistake commercial OCCT add-ons or OCCT-derived parsers/consumers for an open-source independent-kernel vote

planChanges: Clarified that current ezdxf stable ACIS docs advertise SAT and SAB export, while the FAQ contradicts this; required a pinned exact operation probe before relying on either API claim.
Strengthened the restriction that ezdxf unsupported/NONE_ENTITY records are loss and cannot prove arbitrary ACIS round-trip semantics.
Reaffirmed that OCCT ACIS exchange is a commercial add-on, outside the open-source core, and shares OCCT kernel lineage with FreeCAD and cq-acis.
Added a generated AC1032 REGION/SAB/ACDSDATA test-design lead from LibreDWG issue #1411 without importing the confidential peer sample or treating the report as reproduced evidence.
Added a fast-lane/composed-gate sequence that preserves local 2D/DXF and DWG carrier/owner-graph progress when independent kernel evidence is unavailable.
limitations: Repository and documentation pages are mutable; the ezdxf stable documentation exposes a direct internal inconsistency and must be checked against an exact package before relying on SAB generation.
No general independent open-source ACIS kernel was identified in the reviewed sources; this is a scoped research result, not proof that no such project exists anywhere.
No peer source was pinned to a commit except the commit named in the LibreDWG issue report; no package, application, converter, or kernel was executed.
No external drawing was downloaded; no peer fixture or mutated external corpus was added.
